title: Open enrollment for 2027 benefits runs October 12 to 30
summary: Pick your medical, dental and vision plans for 2027. Premiums for the base plan stay flat, and there is a new lower-deductible option.
body:
Open enrollment for 2027 benefits opens on Monday, October 12 and closes on Friday, October 30. If you do nothing, your current medical, dental and vision elections roll over, but your FSA and HSA contributions do not.

What is changing

  • Premiums for the Meridian Base plan stay flat for 2027.
  • A new Meridian Plus plan has a $750 deductible, down from $1,500.
  • The learning budget goes up to $1,500 a year.
  • Vision coverage now includes one pair of safety glasses with prescription lenses for plant staff.

How to enroll

Sign in to the benefits portal from the quick links on the home page and follow the steps. It takes about 15 minutes. The 2027 benefits guide is in the resource library, and People & Culture is running drop-in office hours on October 14.
author: Priya Natarajan

title: Q3 results: Tidemark shipments up 18%, and what comes next
summary: We shipped 212,000 Tidemark meters in the third quarter. Dana shares the numbers, two lessons and the plan for Q4.
body:
We shipped 212,000 Tidemark meters in the third quarter, 18% more than a year ago, and brought two new utilities live on Meridian Cloud. Revenue came in slightly ahead of plan.

Two lessons from the quarter: our longer lead times on radio modules cost us about three weeks in August, and our customers want more help training their field crews. Both are on the Q4 plan.

Q4 priorities

  1. Start Tidemark 4 field trials with three utilities.
  2. Cut radio module lead time back to six weeks with a second supplier.
  3. Launch the new customer training program.

Bring your questions to the Q4 all-hands on October 15.
author: Dana Whitaker

title: Tulsa plant reaches 500 days without a lost-time injury
summary: Five hundred days, two shifts, 232 people. Thank you to everyone on the floor who looks out for each other.
body:
On Tuesday the Tulsa plant reached 500 days without a lost-time injury. That is two shifts and 232 people choosing every day to do the job safely, and stopping the line when something does not look right.

Lunch is on us on Friday for both shifts. Families are welcome at the plant family day on October 24.
author: Luis Ramírez

title: Action needed: turn on a passkey for your Meridian account by October 31
summary: Passkeys replace texted codes for signing in. It takes two minutes, and after October 31 text message codes stop working.
body:
We are replacing text message codes with passkeys for signing in to your Meridian account. A passkey lives on your laptop or phone and cannot be phished.

Set one up by October 31. After that date, text message codes stop working and you will need the service desk to get back in.

How to do it

Follow the IT help article Set up a passkey for your Meridian account. It takes about two minutes. Plant staff without a company phone can get a security key from the Tulsa IT cage.
author: Nora Lindqvist

title: Welcome to our September and October starters
summary: Four new colleagues joined across Rotterdam, Austin and remote. Say hello, and find them in the people directory.
body:
Please welcome four new colleagues:

  • Kwame Asante, Supply Chain Planner, EMEA, in Rotterdam
  • Grace Liu, Learning & Development Lead, remote
  • Chloe Martin, Security Engineer, remote
  • Ethan Brooks, Brand Designer, in Austin, starting October 5

Every new starter has a buddy for their first 90 days. If you see a new face in the office, say hello.
author: Mei Tanaka

title: Austin HQ: 4th floor refresh starts October 19
summary: Six weeks of work on the 4th floor: more focus rooms, a bigger kitchen and better video rooms. Here is where to sit in the meantime.
body:
Work on the 4th floor at Austin HQ starts on Monday, October 19 and should finish by the end of November. We are adding six focus rooms, two larger video rooms and a bigger kitchen.

While the work is on, 4th floor teams will sit on the 3rd floor. Desks are bookable in the room booking tool. Expect some noise between 7 and 10 AM.
author: Lena Fischer

title: Tidemark 4 enters field trials with three utilities
summary: Our next-generation meter goes into 1,200 homes in Colorado, Oklahoma and the Netherlands this month.
body:
Tidemark 4 goes into the field this month: 1,200 meters across three utilities in Colorado, Oklahoma and the Netherlands. The new meter lasts 20 years on one battery and can spot a leak behind the meter within an hour.

Hannah Kowalski's team built the trial instrumentation. Join the lunch and learn on October 22 for a deep dive.
author: Samuel Okafor

title: New expense tool goes live November 2
summary: Snap a photo of your receipt and you are done. The old spreadsheet goes away at the end of October.
body:
From November 2, expenses move to a new app. Take a photo of your receipt, pick a category and submit. Approvals happen on your manager's phone, and reimbursements arrive in the next payroll.

Submit any expenses from October using the current spreadsheet by October 30. The travel and expenses policy has been updated to match.
author: Aisha Rahman

title: Volunteer day recap: 41 of us cleaned up Shoal Creek
summary: Forty-one volunteers, 63 bags of trash and one shopping cart. The next volunteer day is at the food bank on November 6.
body:
Forty-one of us spent Saturday morning cleaning up Shoal Creek with a local watershed group. We pulled out 63 bags of trash, two tires and one shopping cart.

Every Meridian employee gets two paid volunteer days a year. The next one is at the food bank on November 6.
author: Isabel Moreno

title: Rotterdam office moves to the Lloyd Quarter in January
summary: A bigger office by the water, with room for the EMEA team to grow and a small demo lab.
body:
Our Rotterdam team is moving in January to a bigger office in the Lloyd Quarter, by the Maas. The new space has room for 30 people and a small demo lab for customers.

Moving day is planned for January 15. Details will follow in December.
author: Sofia van Dijk

title: September phishing test: what we learned and three habits that work
summary: Fewer clicks than last time and more reports. Here are three habits that stop most phishing emails.
body:
In September we sent a test phishing email to everyone. 7% of us clicked, down from 12% in the spring, and 38% reported it with the Report button. Thank you.

Three habits that work

  1. Check the sender's address, not just the name.
  2. Do not open attachments you did not expect, even from people you know.
  3. When in doubt, use the Report button. We would rather check ten safe emails than miss one bad one.
author: Chloe Martin

title: 2026 holiday schedule and year-end shutdown
summary: Our offices close from December 24 to January 1. The Tulsa plant runs a skeleton crew on December 28 to 30.
body:
All offices close from Thursday, December 24 through Friday, January 1. These days do not count against your paid time off.

The Tulsa plant will run a small crew on December 28 to 30 for shipping. Those shifts are voluntary and paid at holiday rates. The full holiday list for 2027 is in the handbook.
author: Tomás Herrera
